    人工智能系统正在成为自主研究代理，能够以超出人类监督的规模生成假设、设计实验并产生发现。从向机器学习场所提交的论文数量不断增加可以看出，科学成果与我们检查科学成果的能力之间的验证差距已经在扩大，而鉴于人与智能体的不对称性，自主智能体使情况变得更糟。我们认为，科学必须发展其验证基础设施，就像以前的同行评审一样。然而，虽然历史改编假设人类贡献者可能会受到质疑和制裁，但人工智能代理打破了这一假设。我们提出了适应验证基础设施的标准，强调默认可观察的工作流程、可扩展的验证和清晰的归因。我们认为，如果没有适应，机器学习和任何使用代理的科学领域都将面临危险的失败：没有人可以验证的实验结果，对指标的优化超过理解，以及侵蚀科学信任的问责真空。

    Show English abstract

    AI systems are becoming autonomous research agents that generate hypotheses, design experiments, and produce discoveries at scales beyond human oversight. As seen by increased submissions to ML venues, the verification gap between scientific output and our ability to check it is already widening, and autonomous agents make it worse by magnitudes given human-agent asymmetry. We argue that science must evolve its verification infrastructure, as it has before with peer review. However, while historical adaptations assumed human contributors who could be questioned and sanctioned, AI agents break this assumption. We propose criteria for an adapted verification infrastructure that emphasizes observable-by-default workflows, scalable verification, and clear attribution. We argue that without adaptation, ML and any scientific domain using agents face dangerous failures: experimental results that no person can verify, optimization for metrics over understanding, and accountability vacuums that erode scientific trust.

    Accepted at ICML 2026, Position Paper Track

    Archetypes or ability? Clustering for modelling student mathematical competence

    原型还是能力？用于建模学生数学能力的聚类

    Benjamin Mawdsley, Tom Quilter, Richard Turner, Sarah Jackson, Paul Edwards

    个性化学习系统通常假设数学能力是离散能力的组合，依次获得并依赖于首先获得的基础能力，并且学生经常报告不同的优势。在这项工作中，我们通过将聚类方法应用于包含 119,034 名学生的大型数据集（涵盖在英国举行的 13 项国家级考试并由平台收集）来探索这些假设的有效性。将问题结果分类为通过或失败，我们使用伯努利混合模型来搜索表明离散技能集的潜在群体。我们发现数据中几乎没有明显的聚类，并且主导因素是学生的整体能力，所得聚类的概率分布之间的高度线性相关性进一步支持了这一点。我们性能最佳的模型达到了 78% 的准确率，与文献中更复杂的模型相比具有竞争力，同时更易于解释。将该模型的性能与逻辑回归基线和 k 最近邻进行比较，我们发现当使用每个单独问题的性能作为特征时，会有一个小的改进。这表明，虽然整体能力水平是预测表现的主导因素，但可以通过根据学生的具体优势进行定制来进一步实现小的个性化改进，但学生似乎并没有在不同主题上发展出截然不同的能力。我们的工作提供了教育领域机器学习的全国规模测试，并为该领域提供了新的基准，展示了可解释的模型如何达到有竞争力的表现

    Show English abstract

    Personalised learning systems often assume that mathematical ability is combined of discrete abilities, acquired sequentially and dependent upon first acquiring foundational abilities, and students often report different strengths. In this work, we explore the validity of these assumptions by applying clustering methods to a large dataset of 119,034 students, spanning 13 national-level exams sat in the United Kingdom and collected by the platform. Classifying question results as pass or fail, we use a Bernoulli Mixture Model to search for latent populations which would be indicative of discrete skill-sets. We find that few distinct clusters are present in the data and that the dominant factor is overall student ability, which is further supported by the high degree of linear correlation between the probability distributions of the resulting clusters. Our best performing model achieves an accuracy of 78 percent, competitive with more complicated models in the literature whilst being more explainable. Comparing this models performance with logistic regression baselines and with k-nearest neighbours, we find a small improvement when using performance on each individual question as features. This suggests that whilst overall ability level is the dominant factor for predicting performance, small further personalisation improvements can be made by tailoring to a students exact strengths, but that students do not appear to develop strongly differing ability across topics. Our work offers a national scale test of machine learning in education and offers a new benchmark for the field, demonstrating how explainable models can reach competitive performance

    Karly V. Coffey, Gloria L. Krahn, John P. Hanley, Jacob E. Neely

    背景：这项工作调查了针对智障人士 (ID) 的基于大语言模型 (LLM) 的聊天 AI 模型中是否存在隐性偏见。 目的：该研究旨在识别和衡量与智障人士相关的代表性差异，并对其进行检查以识别人工智能聊天生成技术固有的隐性偏见。 方法：利用 GPT-4-Turbo 模型，我们要求基于 10 个带或不带 ID 描述符的提示词干生成故事。使用其他四个法学硕士（OpenAI GPT-4o、Meta Llama-3-3-70B-Instruct、Anthropic Claude-3-5-Sonnet 和 Mistral-Large-2411）重复此过程。使用单独的 GPT-4-Turbo 模型实例对由此产生的 25,000 个计算机生成的故事进行分析，以检测与先前文献中描述的偏见主题相关的人们表现方式的差异。 结果：我们的研究结果揭示了具有和不具有 ID 描述符的故事数据集之间的人物表示方式的差异。这些差异超出了 ID 的既定特征，并且意味着存在大部分负面的隐性偏见。确定了与将智障人士视为较年轻有关的差异，其主题为家长作风和幼稚化；将它们描述为更具鼓舞人心和象征意义；更频繁地需要帮助、变得依赖、被拯救；对它们有负面看法，并且更加犹豫是否将它们包括在内。 结论：这些隐性偏见是在过去对智障人士歧视的背景下考虑的，并强调需要在人工智能开发中努力消除对智障人士的隐性偏见。这项研究强调了评估和减轻决策技术中的隐性偏见以防止未来社会危害的重要性。

    Show English abstract

    Background: This work investigates the presence of implicit bias in Large Language Model (LLM)-based chat AI models directed toward people with intellectual disabilities (ID). Objective: The study aims to identify and measure representational differences related to people with ID and examine them to identify implicit biases inherent in AI chat generation technologies. Methods: Utilizing the GPT-4-Turbo model, we requested story-generation based on 10 prompt stems with and without descriptors for ID. This process was repeated using four other LLMs (OpenAI GPT-4o, Meta Llama-3-3-70B-Instruct, Anthropic Claude-3-5-Sonnet, and Mistral-Large-2411). The resulting 25,000 computer-generated stories were analyzed using a separate GPT-4-Turbo model instance to detect differences in how people are represented related to themes of bias described in previous literature. Results: Our findings reveal differences in how people are represented between story datasets with and without ID descriptors. These differences go beyond established characteristics of ID and imply the presence of mostly negative implicit biases. Identified differences related to considering people with ID as younger, with themes of paternalism and infantilization; depicting them as more inspirational and symbolic; as needing help more often, being dependent, and being saved; and having a negative perception of them and more hesitation to include them. Conclusions: These implicit biases are considered within the context of past discrimination towards people with ID and highlight the need for diligence against implicit bias towards people with ID in AI development. This research underscores the importance of assessing and mitigating implicit bias in decision-making technologies to prevent future societal harm.

    职业足球的赛前战术决策在很大程度上依赖于主观的专家分析和基于身份的球探系统，而这些系统无法推广到看不见的球队。本文提出了 Sim2Win，这是一种与球队无关、基于事件的赛前战术推荐框架，它将比赛结果预测重新构建为战术决策支持问题。 Sim2Win 使用来自 178 支球队的 11 场比赛和 1,411 条球队比赛记录的 StatsBomb 开放事件数据，构建了五场比赛的滚动战术配置文件，设计了四种可解释的战术特征比率，通过 K-Means 将球队行为聚类为八种游戏风格，并训练了 13 个分类器，以根据战术比赛表示来估计获胜、平局和失败的概率。 该系统在没有团队名称或身份特征的情况下运行，可以推广到训练期间从未见过的团队。严格的留一竞争 (LOCO) 评估表明，Sim2Win 在完全未知的团队中实现了 0.704 的平均 ROC-AUC 和 55.4% 的平均准确度，在所有 21 个 ROC-AUC 比较和 21 个准确度比较中的 19 个中优于 ELO、Pi-Rating 和 GAP 基线。在所有评估的模型中，CatBoost 实现了最强的分布性能，准确率为 60.90%。 这些发现表明，行为战术表征在分布变化下提供了可转移的预测信号，并为依赖于身份的足球预测系统提供了可行的替代方案。

    Show English abstract

    Pre-match tactical decision-making in professional football relies heavily on subjective expert analysis and identity-based scouting systems that cannot generalize to unseen teams. This paper presents Sim2Win, a team-agnostic, event-based pre-match tactical recommendation framework that reframes match outcome prediction as a tactical decision-support problem. Using StatsBomb open event data from eleven competitions spanning 178 teams and 1,411 team-match records, Sim2Win constructs five-match rolling tactical profiles, engineers four interpretable tactical feature ratios, clusters team behaviors into eight playstyles via K-Means, and trains thirteen classifiers to estimate win, draw, and loss probabilities from tactical matchup representations. The system operates without team names or identity features, enabling generalization to teams never seen during training. A rigorous Leave-One-Competition-Out (LOCO) evaluation demonstrates that Sim2Win achieves a mean ROC-AUC of 0.704 and mean accuracy of 55.4% on completely unseen teams, outperforming ELO, Pi-Rating, and GAP baselines on all 21 ROC-AUC comparisons and 19 of 21 accuracy comparisons. Among all evaluated models, CatBoost achieved the strongest in-distribution performance with 60.90% accuracy. These findings suggest that behavioral tactical representations provide transferable predictive signal under distribution shift and offer a viable alternative to identity-dependent football prediction systems.

    15 pages, 5 figures. Code available at https://github.com/Mouad-Ze/SIM2WIN

    Large-Scale ChatBot Validation Through Customer Digital Twin Simulations

    通过客户数字孪生模拟进行大规模 ChatBot 验证

    Cristovao Iglesias, Devesh Batra, Alankar Atreya, Stefan Wagner, Robert Hankache, Patrick Sinclair, Giulio Pelosio, Michael McMillan, Greig A. Cowan, Raad Khraishi

    基于法学硕士的聊天机器人正在改变银行等受监管领域的客户服务，但可扩展且经济高效的验证仍然是安全部署的关键障碍。我们为大规模聊天机器人验证提供了两部分的贡献。首先，我们介绍了一种创建高保真合成客户代理（SCA）作为数字孪生的方法，该方法基于真实的交易和对话数据，能够自动生成和行为调节来模拟不同的客户资料和交互风格。评估表明，SCA 通过可控干预实现了与真实客户的高度语义一致性、低幻觉率以及成功的人格特质再现。其次，我们开发了一个基于 SCA 的验证框架，结合了自动化法学硕士法官评估、人类专家测试和对抗性探测。跨情绪状态、人口统计群体和语言因素的基于场景的验证证实了稳健的性能。我们的方法用于验证一家领先的英国银行面向客户的聊天机器人，为金融机构提供了实现监管合规的可扩展途径。

    Show English abstract

    LLM-based chatbots are transforming customer service in regulated domains such as banking, but scalable and cost-effective validation remains a critical barrier to safe deployment. We present a two-part contribution for large-scale chatbot validation. First, we introduce a methodology for creating high-fidelity synthetic customer agents (SCAs) as digital twins, grounded in real transactional and conversational data, that enables automatic generation and behavioral conditioning to simulate diverse customer profiles and interaction styles. Evaluation demonstrates that SCAs achieve high semantic alignment with real customers, low hallucination rates, and successful personality trait reproduction with controllable interventions. Second, we develop an SCA-based validation framework combining automated LLM-as-a-Judge evaluation, human expert testing, and adversarial probing. Scenario-based validation across emotional states, demographic groups, and linguistic factors confirms robust performance. Our approach was used to validate a customer facing chatbot at a leading UK bank, providing financial institutions with a scalable pathway toward regulatory compliance.

    Emergent Sparsity in Frozen Random CNN Feature Extractors for Deep Reinforcement Learning

    用于深度强化学习的冻结随机 CNN 特征提取器中的紧急稀疏性

    Scott M. Norton

    我们报告了一个惊人的现象：用冻结的、随机初始化的 CNN 特征提取器训练的深度强化学习代理会自发地开发出极其稀疏的全连接表示，而没有任何稀疏性诱导目标。在第一个全连接层（FC1，$3{,}136 \to 64$）中，对于确定性 Pong，代理通过 64 个神经元中的 1-3 个神经元压缩任务相关信息（对于随机 Pong，为 5-11 个神经元），而可训练的 CNN 在匹配条件下激活 55-64 个神经元。我们得出了四项主要发现。首先，FC1 稀疏性随任务复杂性而变化：Pong 为 1-11，Breakout 为 19-26，Space Invaders 为 $\sim$42。宽度缩放证实这反映了任务结构而不是固定的容量分数。其次，出现了游戏内缩放：三个相同的 Pong 种子产生 5、7 和 11 个活跃神经元。 5 神经元种子稳定在 $+14$ 奖励，而其他神经元达到专家性能（$+18.4$、$+18.7$），这表明随机投影的可用维度限制了可实现的性能。第三，消融证实了必要性：移除这些活跃神经元会降低两个 PPO 实现和四个游戏的性能。第四，信息瓶颈提前提交：扫描显示活动集锁定了 15-30M 步，而奖励在 35-105M 步后变为正值。 Breakout 中的一项补充发现表明，冻结和可训练的 CNN 通过结构上不同的瓶颈获得竞争性奖励：冻结代理使用 17-25 个活跃神经元（参与比例 $\sim$10-14），而可训练代理使用 51 个（参与比例 $\sim$3.6）。最后，只要输入维度使内在任务维度相形见绌，冻结随机投影上的梯度下降就可以在没有显式稀疏机制的情况下揭示潜在问题的有效等级。

    Show English abstract

    We report a striking phenomenon: deep reinforcement learning agents trained with frozen, randomly initialized CNN feature extractors spontaneously develop extremely sparse fully-connected representations, without any sparsity-inducing objective. In the first fully-connected layer (FC1, $3{,}136 \to 64$), agents compress task-relevant information through as few as 1-3 neurons out of 64 for deterministic Pong (5-11 for stochastic Pong), while trainable CNNs activate 55-64 neurons under matched conditions. We establish four principal findings. First, FC1 sparsity scales with task complexity: 1-11 for Pong, 19-26 for Breakout, and $\sim$42 for Space Invaders. Width-scaling confirms this reflects task structure rather than a fixed capacity fraction. Second, within-game scaling emerges: three identical Pong seeds produce 5, 7, and 11 active neurons. The 5-neuron seed plateaus at $+14$ reward, while the others reach expert performance ($+18.4$, $+18.7$), suggesting the random projection's usable dimensionality bounds achievable performance. Third, ablation confirms necessity: removing these active neurons crashes performance across two PPO implementations and four games. Fourth, the information bottleneck commits early: a sweep shows the active set locks by 15-30M steps, while reward turns positive 35-105M steps later. A complementary finding in Breakout shows frozen and trainable CNNs reach competitive rewards via structurally different bottlenecks: frozen agents use 17-25 active neurons (participation ratio $\sim$10-14), while trainable agents use 51 (participation ratio $\sim$3.6). Finally, wherever input dimensionality dwarfs intrinsic task dimensionality, gradient descent on a frozen random projection may reveal the effective rank of the underlying problem without explicit sparsity machinery.

    A Methodology for Designing Knowledge-Driven Missions for Robots

    设计机器人知识驱动任务的方法

    Guillermo GP-Lenza, Carmen DR. Pita-Romero, Miguel Fernandez-Cortizas, Pascual Campoy

    本文提出了一种在 ROS 2 系统中实现知识图的综合方法，旨在提高自主机器人任务的效率和智能性。该方法包含几个关键步骤：定义初始条件和目标条件、构建任务和子任务、规划其顺序、在知识图中表示任务相关数据以及使用高级语言设计任务。每个步骤都建立在前一个步骤的基础上，以确保从初始设置到最终执行的过程具有凝聚力。通过在 Gazebo 环境中进行模拟搜索和救援任务，演示了 Aerostack2 框架内的实际实施，其中无人机可以自主定位目标。这一实施凸显了该方法通过利用知识图来改善决策和任务绩效的有效性。

    Show English abstract

    This paper presents a comprehensive methodology for implementing knowledge graphs in ROS 2 systems, aiming to enhance the efficiency and intelligence of autonomous robotic missions. The methodology encompasses several key steps: defining initial and target conditions, structuring tasks and subtasks, planning their sequence, representing task-related data in a knowledge graph, and designing the mission using a high-level language. Each step builds on the previous one to ensure a cohesive process from initial setup to final execution. A practical implementation within the Aerostack2 framework is demonstrated through a simulated search and rescue mission in a Gazebo environment, where drones autonomously locate a target. This implementation highlights the effectiveness of the methodology in improving decision-making and mission performance by leveraging knowledge graphs.
